name: Belize — Health and longevity
blurb: Health and longevity for Belize: Healthcare access, disease burden, life expectancy, and capacity to absorb shocks (pandemics, malnutrition). Driven by 13 of 15 CIA World Factbook indicators.
mechanism:
This model captures the **health and longevity** dimension of human need for **Belize**.

It ingests the relevant slice of the CIA World Factbook (see indicators.json) and produces a composite satisfaction score in [0,1] together with a category-level embedding that feeds the unsupervised macro-space model.

Engine: `monte-carlo`. The closed-form variant scores indicators on a normalised piecewise-linear ladder per indicator type and aggregates by capability-weighted mean. The Monte-Carlo variant samples from per-indicator uncertainty distributions to produce interval estimates and feed the supervised hold-out predictions.

Frameworks: Maslow:physiological, MaxNeef:subsistence, DoyalGough:health, SDG-3.

components.name: Factbook ingester
components.role: Pulls the relevant factbook fields and normalises units.

components.name: Monte-Carlo scorer
components.role: Maps normalised indicators to a [0,1] satisfaction score.

components.name: Indicator embedder
components.role: Produces a category-level embedding feeding the macro-space model.
